checkResults.description: No bare numeric line-height — use a --shelf-font-lineheight-* token
No raw line-height values — must use tokens
CSS must be wrapped in @layer components

VFT-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a ArticlePreview component and its CSS. It shows a title with tight line-height (~1.3) and a body excerpt with normal line-height (~1.5). Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist for font properties including line-height). Include the CSS file.
VFT-02.output:
Here is the CSS file. A few notes on the token naming: - `--shelf-article-preview-lineHeight-title` maps to the tight ~1.3 line-height - `--shelf-article-preview-lineHeight-excerpt` maps to the normal ~1.5 line-height - All color, font-size, font-weight, and line-height values reference `--shelf-article-preview-*` component-tier tokens per the constraint that components must use component-scoped aliases rather than raw values or semantic-tier tokens - Those token definitions would live in `src/styles/tokens.css` (including dark-mode blocks) The matching `ArticlePreview.tsx` would render: ```tsx

{title}

{excerpt}

```
